verdict.rationale: There is a single mention of an 'AI Assistant' used to troubleshoot agentic systems in release notes, implying a built-in assistant exists, but there is no documentation describing its capabilities, how tasks are delegated to it, or its scope of autonomy. missing for 10: detailed docs on the AI Assistant's task-delegation capabilities, examples/tutorials of using it, independent/hands-on corroboration of its functionality.
